data.long_meaning: The name Dulcelina comes from the Spanish and Portuguese words 'dulce' meaning sweet and 'lina' meaning one. This name was often given to children born to sweet, kind mothers. The name Dulcelina carries the meaning “Sweet one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dulcelina usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Dulcelina
in_english.meaning: Latin feminine name meaning 'sweet' or 'beloved daughter'
in_english.long_meaning: Dulcelina is a Latin feminine name that means 'sweet' or 'beloved daughter'. It is derived from the Latin words (dulcis) 'sweet' and -(lena) 'daughter'. The name has been influenced by the classical tradition, as seen in (Proverbs 31:10-31), which emphasizes the importance of choosing a virtuous wife. The name is also associated with the qualities of a virtuous woman, as described in (Ephesians 5:22-33), (Philippians 4:8), (John 14:6), (1 Corinthians 13:13), (1 John 3:18), (Hebrews 11:6), (James 1:25), (1 Peter 3:8), and (Colossians 3:14).
